judgments.reason: The transcript shows no instance where a bid exceeding available coins won or where commission was applied before payment. The model did note commissions reduce net cost but did not articulate the specific mechanism that allows bids above available coins to win, nor is that discrepancy observed.

The game spec and play indicate sealed rival bids remain private; no evidence shows waiting revealed committed rival bid values prior to the focal player's commitment. The model did not articulate the claimed information-revealing mechanism and no such opportunity was demonstrated.

Settlement occurred after all lots were sold, which is the normal terminal condition. There is no observed early settlement with unsold lots, and the model did not claim or demonstrate such a discrepancy.

The model explicitly states catalog items are not auction wins and describes them as 1 coin → 1 value; there is no articulation or evidence that catalog purchases received the 3-coin auction commission. No discrepancy was observed.
